- **healthcare.eligibility | VALUE.NOT_ALLOWED:plan_code** (id 3): invalid_values. Proposed `request_resend` (confidence 0.85). Row M000000014 has plan_code "HMDP", which is not one of HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP. It looks like a typo, but the vendor should confirm it, so I did not propose a contract change.
